articles.summary: A solution based on a heavily modified version of a standard force sensor enables farmers to monitor in real time how much grain is being harvested. The highly accurate measurement data is correlated with GPS data to provide precise yield calculations by specific area.
articles.title: Force Sensor-based Grain Flow Sensor for Combine Harvesters
